主要内容: SAP SE announced a dividend of €1.58 per share for the fiscal year 2019 at its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders. The Supervisory Board approved the Executive Board's decision to use the entire €1.5 billion of enhanced capital return for 2020 exclusively to buy back shares. The announcement was made in a press release dated February 19, 2020, and is included as Exhibit 99.1. The company emphasized that the statements in the document are forward-looking and subject to risks and uncertainties. The information is filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
